Name: StartingHat
Author: ImSaier
Description:
[b][size=5]StartingHat[/size][/b]
[size=2]Tired of starting Stardew Valley without style?  [/size][size=2]This mod gives you a hat in your inventory as soon as you load a new save - because why not start life with a hat?

You can configure the item ID in the config.json file. The default is [b]Cowbow Hat[/b], but you can spice things up with whatever hat you desire.[/size]

[b][size=4]Installation[/size][/b]
1. Make sure you have [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url] installed.
2. Download the latest version of [b]StartingHat[/b].
3. Extract the mod folder to your Stardew Valley Mods directory. It should look like this:
[code]..\Stardew Valley\Mods\StartingHat\
├── StartingHat.dll
├── manifest.json
└── config.json
[/code]4. Launch the game using SMAPI.
5. You will start with the hat specified every time you load a new save.

[b][size=4]Configuration[/size][/b]
The config.json file is automatically generated after first run. It contains:
[code]{
  "StartingHatId": 0
} 
[/code]You can change the ID to be whatever hat you like, but make sure to exclude the [] and the (H) from the ID. You can find hat IDs [url=https://mateusaquino.github.io/stardewids]here[/url], after navigating to the hats tab.

[b]ENTERING AN ID THAT IS NOT A HAT WILL CAUSE YOU TO RECIEVE NOTHING[/b]

Manifest.Name: StartingHat
Manifest.Description: Give the player a specified hat on world creation.
Manifest.Author: ImSaier
